verdict.rationale: Puzzle's own marketing documents first-party connections to Stripe (payments) and to Ramp and Brex (spend and banking), and says customers who 'connect supported integrations' close their books faster. That indicates activity flows into the ledger, but only through thin marketing lines. Missing for 10: any payroll integration evidence, a documented list of direct bank-feed connections, setup docs explaining how synced transactions post to the ledger automatically, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my banking, payments, and payroll systems so their activity flows into the ledger automatically

citations.quote: 3 min to reconcile revenue When you connect Stripe with Puzzle
2x faster to close books When you connect Ramp with Puzzle
98% transactions categorized When you connect Brex with Puzzle
Puzzle customers who fully onboard and connect supported integrations can reduce the time required to complete their monthly close by 50% or more
